BiblicalUsage: The word is the setting of a gem, and it belongs to the breastplate of judgment: four rows of stones, each one set in gold, with the names of the tribes of Israel engraved upon them and carried over Aaron's heart.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the setting is the sermon: God's people are not loose stones but set jewels, each one held in place and carried before the Lord.
